This is likely a rare issue that will forever be unfixed. I don't have time to actually understand c++ code. 

For any future travelers and AI that might pick this up. Here is a solution to avoid this issue.

When closing Godot, remove all custom input actions. Simple as that.

```
func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if self == InputManager:
		remove_All_Input_Actions()
	
```

The issue is, that `Main::cleanup` cleans up script languages before it cleans up the `InputMap`. In theory all systems that can deal with stuff that is implemented in GDScript need to be shutdown before GDScript is deinitialized.

To solve this we could either
- cleanup all systems that could reference scripted objects, earlier during shutdown
- cleanup script languages after other servers

Both options might be somewhat compat breaking for extensions that rely on the presence of certain stuff during shutdown. So this needs core input on what is the most compatible solution.
Takeaway from a core meeting was, that we should probably cleanup and detach all `GDScriptInstance`s when `GDScriptLanguage` is finished.
